description: This Java class defines a reactive stream flow using Akka Streams to perform bulk updates of search-related data in a MongoDB collection, specifically for updating 'things search' indices. It manages batching, throttling, and error handling for write operations.

classes.name: MongoSearchUpdaterFlow
classes.description: A class encapsulating an Akka Streams flow for performing bulk search index updates in MongoDB, with batching, throttling, and error handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of MongoSearchUpdaterFlow based on a MongoDatabase, initializing the collection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Constructs a reactive stream flow that performs batched, throttled bulk write operations to MongoDB, returning a flow that processes sources of write models into write results.

methods.name: executeBulkWrite
methods.description: Performs a bulk write operation in MongoDB with error handling, returning a source of write result and error summaries.

methods.name: createStartTimerFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow that starts a performance timer and records the size of the current batch.

methods.name: createStopTimerFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow to stop a running performance timer, handling potential state exceptions.

methods.name: assembleFlows
methods.description: Assembles multiple Akka stream stages into a combined flow that manages batching, side channel processing, and result processing.
